title: GPT-5.6 tier comparison for project orientation
hypothesis: Terra or Luna can improve LCA's latency or token-cost tradeoff over Sol without losing grounded project-orientation quality.
falsified_if: Neither Terra nor Luna is non-inferior to Sol on deterministic pass rate and mean score while improving latency, token use, or estimated API cost without a material regression in the others.
efficiency_outcomes: prompt, cached, cache-write, and output tokens
estimated input, cached-input, and output cost at published prices
decision_rule: Do not change the Sol default from this scenario alone. A cheaper tier is a candidate only if five runs are non-inferior on pass rate and mean score. Prefer the least expensive candidate inside a 10-point score band unless latency is materially worse, then validate coding and recovery scenarios.
